Extract schema.org microdata for Organization

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"extract_metadata\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<html><head><title>Company</title></head><body><div itemscope itemtype=\"https://schema.org/Organization\"><span itemprop=\"name\">Acme Corp</span><span itemprop=\"foundingDate\">2020</span><span itemprop=\"url\">https://acmecorp.example.com</span><span itemprop=\"logo\">https://acmecorp.example.com/logo.png</span></div></body></html>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
